transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

They brought me in after something at the fair. I was giving a talk and… I got up on the tractor and started messing with the controls, showing some “new pattern” I thought I needed to show. People were yelling at me to stop, but I just… couldn’t make myself stop right then.
Had you taken any drugs or alcohol before this happened?
No… not that I remember. I don’t really mess with that much. I wasn’t drinking before it, far as I know.
Before the fair incident, did you feel unusually high, excited, or full of energy?

Yeah… some mornings I’d wake up feeling like everything was wide open, like the whole valley was mine somehow. I’d be grinning for no reason.

But if someone told me to slow down, or questioned me… I’d get mad quick. Snapped more than I should’ve.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people couldn’t?

Yeah… sometimes. Out by the north pasture, mostly near dusk. I hear voices, clear enough, coming through the irrigation lines. They’ll say which rows are poisoned or… blessed.

It’s not just when I’m all wound up, either. Happens even on quieter weeks.
Have you ever had a period where you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t know… not like that, I guess. I’ve had bad stretches, sure, but I don’t really keep track of it day by day.
When you hear those voices, are you feeling completely normal in your mood at the same time?

Not completely normal, maybe… but there were weeks I wasn’t all fired up or thinking I was something special.

Quieter weeks. And I’d still hear the lines talking. Still thought the farm data had warnings hidden in it.
Before the voices and hidden-warning beliefs started, had you had any major medical problem or head injury?
Not that I can point to. I mean… I’ve had bumps and wear and tear, working the land, but no major head injury or big medical thing that I know of before all that.
Before the voices first started, had you used methamphetamine or another stimulant?
I’m not really sure. I didn’t keep track of that kind of thing. Nothing I’d know to point to before it started.
Was there ever a stretch of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voices even though you were not feeling especially up or irritable?

Yeah… there were a few stretches like that. Quieter weeks, I guess. I wasn’t especially wound up or thinking big about myself, but I’d still hear the lines talking… and still felt like the farm data had warnings tucked in it.
Was there ever a time when the voices lasted for at least two weeks while your mood felt completely normal?

Yeah… I think so. There were several quieter weeks where my mood felt pretty normal, not especially energized or anything, but the voices were still there. The farm data still felt like it had warnings in it.
